payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the image show the background changed into a recognizable basketball court?
node.criteria: Complete only when s1 and s3 support a recognizable basketball-court background; s2 alone, including equipment or isolated markings, establishes at most progress. Partial when s2 or other support evidence shows basketball-related progress but s3 fails to establish a coherent court background. Absent when supports show no requested progress. Unknown when necessary evidence is unresolved; do not infer visual facts beyond the supports.
node.binding: Target: The background is visibly a basketball court, with recognizable court features such as a playing surface and court markings or basketball equipment.. Reference: The input image and the requested background change in R1..
